_comment: CSV columns the schema-matching LLM judged an exact match. Edit freely. enabled=false skips an entry. value_map translates source values; '_default' is used for values not listed.

mappings.note: LLM said 'exact match' by name, but values (individual/family_floater/senior_citizen) are plan types, not DI/CI/AC/TL/CI-CANCER. Enabling this fails every unit at level 0.
